_comment: GOLDEN CASES — operator-authored ground truth for apply_event_to_projection + rebuild_projection. PROPOSED (not yet frozen). Once frozen, editing requires SPEC: tag + operator action per AUTONOMY_CHARTER §12. These are the cheapest true externality: assertions the agent did NOT author. If implementation passes contract tests but fails a golden case, that's a JOINT_WRONG finding — the most dangerous class (everything else looked green).

cases.name: create then edit round-trip: projection matches rebuild
cases.description: Create an inbox item, edit its content. After both ops, rebuild_projection must reproduce the items table exactly.

cases.name: create-move-state-date-delete-restore round-trip
cases.description: Full lifecycle: create in inbox, move to A, mark blocked (with reason), set due date, mark done, soft-delete, restore. Rebuild must reproduce.

cases.name: swap at cap: A full, swap incoming inbox item with an A item
cases.description: Fill A to 5 active, create an inbox item, swap_move the inbox item into A (demoting one A item to B). After swap: A still 5 active, B +1 active, rebuild reproduces.

cases.name: concurrent-shaped creates into empty tier: all land, rebuild reproduces
cases.description: Three creates into an empty C tier in sequence (simulating rapid capture). All land; rebuild reproduces.

cases.name: blocked-then-unblock at cap: unblock refuses when A is full
cases.description: Fill A to 5 active. Block one (frees a slot). Fill the slot with a 6th active. Try to unblock the blocked one -> CAP_EXCEEDED. Rebuild reproduces the blocked state.

cases.name: delete then re-delete: second delete is NO_ITEM_TO_DELETE or ITEM_NOT_FOUND
cases.description: Create, delete, try to delete again. The second delete must error (item already soft-deleted). Rebuild reproduces the single soft-deleted state.

cases.name: LLM_SUGGESTION_GENERATED does not touch projection
cases.description: Append an LLM_SUGGESTION_GENERATED event directly. The projection must be unchanged — the LLM firewall holds (advisory only, no mutations). Rebuild reproduces.
